question: Will nationwide voting for the 26th Knesset take place on October 27, 2026?
resolution_criteria: Yes if nationwide election-day voting for the 26th Knesset takes place on October 27, 2026, per the Central Elections Committee or a consensus of credible reporting. Disruption in a few localities still counts as yes. No if voting is moved to another date.
